name: Borderless Fullscreen
description: Ticked, the game is borderless: it runs in its own Windowed mode and lid-borderless.dll takes the window's title bar and edges away, so Alt+Tab is instant. Set the game's resolution to your monitor's and it fills the screen; at a lower one the window sits in the middle. Unticked, the game goes back to its normal fullscreen and the plugin is switched off.
author: KSFA

patches.description: The game starts in its Windowed mode, for the plugin to make borderless
